audit_items.proof_trace: The `cancel()` function sets `s_saleStatus.isCanceled = true` (a terminal, irreversible flag — no reset path exists). Every concrete implementation gates `invest`, `publishSaleResults`, `supplyTokens`, and `claimTokenAllocation` behind the `whenSaleNotCanceled` modifier, which reverts via `_verifySaleNotCanceled()` when `isCanceled` is true. `LegionPreLiquidApprovedSale` independently applies the same pattern at its own function signatures.
